summary: Completed testing of iteration 70 features from ideias CreditoIMO.txt. All features verified: O8 undo toast, O21 yellow badge contrast, O9 mobile card views, O17 password strength indicator, O6 skeleton loaders, E1.4 employment_type persistence, E1.8 overflow-x-auto for documents.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All features from iteration 70 have been verified. The app is a Portuguese CRM for mortgage/real estate. Key features tested: 1) O8 - UsersManagementPage delete user uses undo toast with 'Desfazer' button (lines 180-210), 2) O21 - Yellow badges use text-yellow-900 for better contrast in ExpiringDocumentsDashboard.jsx (lines 100, 335) and DocumentSearchPanel.jsx (line 513), 3) O9 - Mobile card views in ClientsPage.js (lines 496, 568) and FilteredProcessList.js (lines 243, 283) using md:hidden/hidden md:block pattern, 4) O17 - Password strength indicator in UsersManagementPage.js (lines 345-370), 5) O6 - Skeleton loaders in AdminDashboard.js, FilteredProcessList.js, ClientRegistrationsPage.js, 6) E1.4 - employment_type field in FinancialData model (backend/models/process.py line 294) and saved via financial_data.model_dump() in public.py line 170, 7) E1.8 - overflow-x-auto in ProcessDetails.js AccordionContent for documents (line 2454).

O8_undo_toast.details: handleDeleteUser uses toast with 'Desfazer' button and onAutoClose for actual deletion

O21_yellow_badge_contrast.details: Changed from text-white to text-yellow-900 for better contrast

O9_mobile_card_views.details: Mobile card view with md:hidden, desktop table with hidden md:block

O17_password_strength_indicator.details: Shows strength bar with 5 levels: Muito fraca, Fraca, Razoável, Forte, Muito forte

O6_skeleton_loaders.details: Uses StatsGridSkeleton and TableSkeleton instead of Loader2 spinner

E1_4_employment_type_persistence.details: employment_type field in FinancialData model, saved via financial_data.model_dump()

E1_8_documents_overflow.details: AccordionContent has overflow-x-auto for better scrolling on small screens
